damaged_product: We are sorry about the problem. Please provide your order number, a brief description and clear photos or a video showing the damage, using the seller's official support channel. The merchant should review the evidence and explain the available resolution under its policy.
payment_confirmation: Please share your order reference, transaction reference, payment date and amount through the business's official support channel. The merchant should verify the payment with its payment provider or bank before updating the order. Never share your PIN, password or one-time passcode.
customer_acquisition: Identify your target customers, make your products and prices easy to understand, provide reliable service and encourage referrals. Test low-cost promotions and track which channels bring actual sales rather than just views or likes.
pos_issue: Record the transaction time, amount, terminal reference and available receipt details. Check the terminal and provider transaction history, then contact the POS provider through its official support channel. Avoid repeating a debit until the transaction status is confirmed.
delivery_cost: Delivery charges depend on the seller's delivery policy, parcel size and destination. Please confirm the exact address or area and the items ordered so the seller can provide an accurate quote. This example does not represent a fixed delivery tariff.
social_media_marketing: Use clear, truthful product photos, descriptions, prices and ordering instructions. Post consistently, respond promptly and obtain permission before sharing customer testimonials or images. Track enquiries, orders and sales from each channel to measure results.
order_tracking: Please provide your order number and the phone number used when placing the order. We can then check the order record and share the available status. Do not send your banking PIN or password.
business_expenses: Record each expense with date, amount, purpose and supporting receipt. Separate personal and business transactions, group expenses into useful categories and review totals regularly. For tax treatment, consult current Nigerian guidance or a qualified professional.
delivery_delay: We are sorry about the delay. Please share your order number and delivery location so the seller or delivery provider can check the shipment. Delivery dates should only be confirmed after checking the current tracking information.
record_keeping: Keep dated records of sales, purchases, expenses, stock movements, invoices and payments. Reconcile records against bank and payment-provider statements regularly, restrict access to sensitive information and maintain backups. Ask an accountant about applicable record-retention requirements.
profit_calculation: Revenue is the money received from sales. To calculate gross profit, subtract the cost of goods sold from sales revenue. For net profit, also subtract relevant operating expenses, taxes and other applicable costs. Use actual records rather than estimates where possible.
supplier_onboarding: Check the supplier's business identity, references, product quality, return terms, delivery arrangements and payment details. Start with a manageable order where practical. Verify account details independently and keep invoices, receipts and written agreements.
selling_price: Start with the purchase cost per unit, then add attributable expenses such as transport, packaging and applicable operating costs. Choose a margin that fits your market and customers. Compare similar products, and make sure the final price is clearly communicated.
supplier_price_change: Compare the new quotation with other reliable suppliers, including transport, quality, minimum order quantity and payment terms. Recalculate your unit cost and profit margin before changing your selling price. Keep written records of agreed prices.
daily_sales: Record each transaction with its date, item, quantity, amount and payment method. Add the transactions for the day and reconcile cash, transfers and card/POS receipts. Keep sales revenue separate from profit and expenses.
refund_request: Refund eligibility and timing depend on the seller's published policy and the circumstances of the order. Please provide the order number, reason for the request and relevant evidence through the official support channel. Do not promise a refund until the merchant has reviewed it.
payment_method: Available payment methods depend on the merchant and its payment provider. Check the official checkout page or contact the merchant using a verified channel. Only pay into account details confirmed by the business, and never disclose your PIN or one-time passcode.
stock_availability: Please check the merchant's current inventory before confirming availability. Stock can change quickly. If the item is unavailable, ask the seller for an expected restock date or suitable alternatives.
inventory_reorder: Review recent sales, current stock, supplier lead time and expected demand before reordering. Set a reorder point based on typical usage during the supplier lead time plus a reasonable safety buffer. Avoid buying more than your cash flow and storage capacity can support.
